calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Podme
calls.summary: PodMe's meeting revolved around adopting an experimentation strategy that embraces collaboration between product managers, developers, and designers to enhance decision-making through measurable outcomes. Key metrics, including subscription conversion rates from free to premium users paying €8/month in Nordic countries, guide this initiative. Currently, PodMe serves around 350,000 subscriptions and reaches 4.5 million users, potentially earning €1.8 million monthly with a 5% conversion rate. A technical integration discussion highlighted GrowthBook's platform capabilities, which support both client and server-side experiments and utilize BigQuery for data management. The team debated tier options, emphasizing that the recommended Enterprise tier offers essential features for safety and scalability, while upcoming limitations on the free version necessitate clarity for future planning.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Open Source, BigQuery, Feature Flags, Experimentation Culture

calls.title: PodMe & Growthbook
calls.summary: The negotiation focused on aligning the enterprise offer with the client’s limited budget and experimentation requirements. The client requested two pricing options—one for 100 experiments at a reduced price and another for 200 experiments at the same rate for flexibility. Timing for contract signing was discussed, with a proposal to delay invoicing until the first experiment launch, considering seasonal constraints. The client, new to experimentation, plans to start cautiously and scale based on results, aiming for operational readiness by October. To facilitate this, onboarding will include setup, training, and AI-assisted tools. Competitive insights revealed that the client is weighing various vendors, with GrowthBook preferred for its secure, warehouse-native architecture.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, A/B Testing, Pricing Negotiation, Onboarding, Data Warehouse Integration, Budget Constraints
